problem_statement: Implement a new public more_itertools.count_runs(iterable) utility. Return the number of maximal consecutive runs of equal elements. Empty input returns 0. Handle generators in a single pass and support unhashable elements through equality (not sets or hashing). The function must be importable from the top-level more_itertools package. Add focused regression tests consistent with this repository. Examples: count_runs([])==0; count_runs([1,1,2,2,1])==3; count_runs(iter([None,None,0]))==2; count_runs([[1],[1],[2]])==2. Do not change unrelated utilities.
public_checks: python -c "from more_itertools import count_runs; assert count_runs([])==0; assert count_runs([1,1,2,2,1])==3; assert count_runs(iter([None,None,0]))==2; assert count_runs([[1],[1],[2]])==2; print('count_runs public contract passed')"
